## Purpose
# Bank Account Filter Parity — Context

## Owns
_None._

## Invariants
1. Bank account filter parameter from URL query is consistently passed to all cashflow service handlers (expense, income) when present.
2. When bankAccountId is selected, both expense and income pages filter transaction queries to that account OR include USER_MANUAL source entries (null bankAccountId).
3. Income service getTotalIncome(), getIncomeEntries(), and getMonthlyIncomeSummaryFiltered() accept optional bankAccountId parameter and apply it to WHERE clause (OR with USER_MANUAL when active).
4. No page renders unfiltered totals if a bank filter is active; parity is enforced at query-binding time, not UI rendering time.
